title: Adversarial fixtures for Legal Interrogation
summary: Qualification should include clauses whose surface wording tempts a model to overreach: exceptions, vague normative predicates, alleged rights, audit powers and contested constitutional language. The point is not to decide the law by fixture; it is to prove that the pipeline asks the missing questions and refuses unsupported collapse.
invariants: The assignment fixture rejects “assignment by any party requires consent” when an Affiliate exception exists.
The constitutional fixture preserves the proposed relation between prefatory militia language and the operative right as REVIEW_REQUIRED rather than silently choosing a contested interpretation.
A demand letter asserting a right must trigger questions about the underlying instrument, ownership/authority, affected party and prerequisites; assertion is not truth.
Vague predicates such as “Good, not Evil” remain unresolved unless an authoritative definition/test is supplied.
Absurd wording is still parsed faithfully; absurdity alone is not a validity/enforceability decision.

provenance.claim: Legal Interrogation dev5 implements clause interrogation, proposition challenge, lifecycle invalidation and a real Intention Service dev11 discovery adapter.
